name: Gather Fellowship
summary: Recruit Bryn (scared of moths) and Quillan (4 soup spells).

name: Whispers in Woods
summary: Travelers whisper of a city hidden in the dark forest.

name: Forest Guardian
summary: Wisps lead you in. The guardian sets three tests.

name: Grumbleback
summary: Get the sacred crystal. Calm the cave beast. It follows you.

name: The Others' Trials
summary: Bryn vs moths. Quillan feeds a giant. Edric admits fear.

name: Citadel in Mist
summary: Cross the cliffs. The crystal opens the giant doors.

name: The Sentinel
summary: All lights die but your beast's glow. Reason with Hesper.

name: Hall of Whispers
summary: A mirror shows fears that are not yours. Walk past them.

name: Doubt Made Flesh
summary: Your own failures fight back. Declare you are still here.

name: Tree of Branches
summary: Pick a path: Bright, Shadowed, or Winding. Rivers are stopping.

name: Realm of Harmony
summary: Get Harmony Shards. Now you hear your beast think in doodles.

name: Grove in Chaos
summary: Twelve friends breathe together. The thorns let go.

name: The Petal Tree
summary: Catch three petals: Wisdom, Courage, Unity.

name: Gateway of Trials
summary: Riddle a shooting star, walk into shadow, stage a show.

name: The Twilight Gift
summary: Point where light meets dark. Dusk lives in your palm now.

name: Crystal of Balance
summary: Answer the Guardian of Dawn's Whisper: an echo.

name: Crystal of Clarity
summary: Never fight Rime in anger. It becomes mist and helps.

name: Crystal of Passion
summary: Forge anything at the obsidian anvil. Cinderwake judges.

name: Crystal of Harmony
summary: An angel with no shadow offers rest. Your beast growls.

name: Rivers Remember
summary: Set four crystals. Every river runs. One crack stays.

name: Luminous Leaves
summary: Step into Eldoria. Glowing trees. Dying crops.

name: Elder Thorne
summary: Thorne coughs. Sethra pretends not to watch him.

name: Supplies at Dawn
summary: Thorne fills your lantern with crystal light.

name: The Forgotten
summary: A fear-fed wraith at the altar. Burn it with hope.

name: But Not Him
summary: Fields are green. Thorne is still sick. Just old.

name: Silent Gales
summary: Sit by the pool until the wind shows a hidden path.

name: Hollow Grove
summary: What can be broken but never held? A promise.

name: Bramble Warden
summary: Purify the despairing guardian. It joins you.

name: Stilled Serpent
summary: It bites Sethra. She silences it herself.

name: Gate of Garden
summary: Not yet. Go home. Take the branch and spices.

name: Six Days
summary: Tea, stories, a planted branch. Carve his tablets.

name: The Tent
summary: Day 1. Sit with Sethra. Nothing else is needed.

name: Up to Her Neck
summary: Day 2. A kind fake angel calls her out of the river.

name: Hidden Doorway
summary: Day 3. A door between trees into a laughing night.

name: The Festival
summary: Day 4. Dance. You cannot fail. Tell your own tale.

name: Gift of Dreams
summary: Day 5. Glowing orbs fall into every hand.

name: Road to the Edge
summary: Day 6. Rattlecart to the Erased Margins. Beast rides shotgun.

name: Malakar Unflowing
summary: The Stilled Sea. Four phases. An empty passenger seat.

name: Rest / 8th Page
summary: Day 7 rest. Day 8 a blank page. Draw what comes next.
